text: The Patriots face the Raiders this Sunday at Gillette Stadium with their secondary significantly depleted—both starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis are unavailable—but there's considerable silver lining in the form of the edge-rushing trio of Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas, who have been exceeding expectations through the first four games and will need to generate pressure on Raiders QB Kirk Cousins, whose torrid start to the season ranks among the NFL's biggest surprises. On the injury front, there's mixed news: running back Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice, providing some offensive help as the team looks to build on recent momentum against Las Vegas. The halftime festivities will add an extra layer of significance to Sunday's matchup, as the Patriots will honor legendary kicker Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction during a ceremony that will stream live on Patriots.com, and if you're into that sort of thing, the team will be wearing throwback uniforms for the occasion.
